name: Fulshear
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fulshear, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fulshear, TX: Cross Creek Ranch tree lighting, a Holiday Movie Night with Elf and the City of Fulshear Tree Lighting and Holiday Market.
lede: Fulshear celebrates Christmas at Cross Creek Ranch and at the Municipal Complex, with two tree lightings, train rides and an outdoor showing of Elf.
celebrates: Christmas in Fulshear mixes neighborhood and city events. Cross Creek Ranch lights its tree at the Welcome Center on November 28 with Santa, a Letter to Santa station and hot chocolate, all with free RSVP tickets. Its Holiday Movie Night shows Elf on the lawn at The Landing on December 3. The City of Fulshear holds its Christmas Tree Lighting and Holiday Market on December 5 from 4 to 7 pm, with train rides, face painting and photos with Santa.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Fulshear held its tree lighting at City Hall, 6611 West Cross Creek Bend Lane, on December 6 from 4 to 7 pm, according to Covering Katy. The 2026 event is on December 5 at the same address and adds a holiday market.
facts: Fulshear is named for Churchill Fulshear, who ran a plantation here. The Texas State Historical Association says the San Antonio and Aransas Pass Railway came through in 1888, a post office opened in 1890 and the city was incorporated in the early 1980s.
trains: A railroad arrived in Fulshear in 1888 with the San Antonio and Aransas Pass Railway. Today the City of Fulshear tree lighting has train rides for children, and the Rosenberg Railroad Museum and Katy depot museum are short drives away.

faq: When is the Fulshear Christmas tree lighting?
The City of Fulshear holds its Christmas Tree Lighting and Holiday Market on December 5 from 4 to 7 pm. Cross Creek Ranch lights its tree on November 28 from 6 to 9 pm.
Is the Cross Creek Ranch tree lighting free?
Yes. The event page offers free RSVP tickets, so reserve before you go.
Are there train rides at the Fulshear tree lighting?
Yes. The city lists train rides, face painting, a Letter to Santa station and photos with Santa.
What movie is shown at Fulshear?
Elf, at the Cross Creek Ranch Holiday Movie Night on December 3 and after the city tree lighting on December 5.
